iPhone Add Site to Homescreen



1. Launch the Safari browser and navigate to XOOMEnergy.com

2. Tap the Share button on the browser’s toolbar — that’s the rectangle with an arrow pointing upward. Tap the Add to Home Screen icon in the Share menu.

Android Add Site to Homescreen



1. Open Chrome on your mobile device, and navigate to XOOMEnergy.com

2.Tap the menu button and tap Add to homescreen. You’ll be able to enter a name for the shortcut and it will be added to your home screen.

Windows Phone Add Site to Homescreen



1. First, open XOOMEnergy.com in Internet Explorer.

2. Tap the More (...) button and tap Pin to Start in the menu that appears.
